-- Read state, issue Run commands. No damage/energy/outcome rules live in this view.
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local CardInput = require("abyss_card_input")
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local M = {}
local L = Theme.layout
local BROWSE_LIFT = 2 -- 搓牌后提起需 2×threshold 上推（估值，非拷贝）
-- Hand gesture intent: separates a lateral nudge from a throw-to-play.
-- Ported behaviour from mature mobile card games (STS mobile / Hearthstone / Snap):
-- once motion is clearly vertical-dominant upward the gesture locks as "play" and a
-- fast upward flick plays a no-target card on release even short of the drop line.
-- Card rules, energy and targeting stay in CardInput / Combat; this only classifies.
local Intent = {}
-- Canvas units (1280x720). lockRatio: vertical must beat lateral by this factor.
local FLICK = {lockDistance=22, lockRatio=1.4, speed=900, minRise=48, window=0.12}
Intent.FLICK = FLICK
local function F() return FLICK end
M.Intent = Intent
function Intent.sample(g, x, y)
    local now = g.elapsed or 0
    local s = g.intentSamples or {}
    g.intentSamples = s
    s[#s+1] = {t=now, x=x, y=y}
    while #s > 12 do table.remove(s, 1) end
    local dx, dy = x - g.sx, y - g.sy
    local f = F()
    if not g.playIntent and dy >= f.lockDistance and dy >= math.abs(dx)*f.lockRatio then
        g.playIntent = true
    end
end
-- Upward velocity (canvas px/s) over the recent window, plus rise from the press point.
function Intent.velocity(g)
    local s = g.intentSamples
    if not s or #s < 2 then return 0, 0 end
    local last, f = s[#s], F()
    local first = s[1]
    for i = #s-1, 1, -1 do
        if last.t - s[i].t > f.window then break end
        first = s[i]
    end
    -- Several native events can arrive inside one frame; treat that as one 60 Hz frame.
    local span = math.max(last.t - first.t, 1/60)
    return (last.y - first.y)/span, (last.x - first.x)/span
end
-- x, y: the release point. It joins the velocity window, and a release past the
-- drop ceiling (top bar / off canvas) or off the sides is never upgraded to a play.
-- Fast vertical-dominant throw, or a locked play intent still moving up decisively.
function Intent.thrown(g)
    local f = F()
    local vy, vx = Intent.velocity(g)
    local rise = (g.y or g.sy) - g.sy
    if vy >= f.speed and rise >= f.minRise and vy >= math.abs(vx)*f.lockRatio then return true end
    return g.playIntent == true and vy >= f.speed*0.6 and rise >= f.minRise*1.5
end
local function releaseOutside(g, x, y)
    return g.dropEnd and y >= g.dropEnd or g.width and math.abs(x) > g.width/2
end
function Intent.flick(g, x, y)
    if g.cancelled or g.aiming or not g.sx then return false end
    if x and y then
        if releaseOutside(g, x, y) then return false end
        Intent.sample(g, x, y)
        g.x, g.y = x, y
    end
    return Intent.thrown(g)
end
-- Explicit ports preserve the approved implementation without a shared constructor closure.
function M.install(owner, ownership, host, dependencies)
    local updateCarry
    local function point(event)
        if not event or type(event.GetUIPos) ~= "function" then return end
        local x,y = event:GetUIPos()
        -- Keep unavailable coordinates compatible, but let field taps reject explicit bad numbers.
        if type(x) == "number" and (x ~= x or math.abs(x) == math.huge)
            or type(y) == "number" and (y ~= y or math.abs(y) == math.huge) then return nil,nil,true end
        if type(x) ~= "number" or type(y) ~= "number" then return end
        local width,height = owner.canvasWidth or Theme.canvas.base[1],owner.canvasHeight or Theme.canvas.base[2]
        local k = math.min(width/Theme.canvas.base[1],height/Theme.canvas.base[2])
        return (x-width/2)/k,(y-height/2)/k
    end
    local function retireInterruptedPress(event)
        local potion=owner.potionAim
        if potion and potion.moving and potion.touch==(event and event.touchId) then
            dependencies.cancelPotionAim();dependencies.cancelPotionInputs();owner.suppressClick=true;owner:render();return true
        end
        local g = owner.gesture
        if not g or g.touch ~= (event and event.touchId) then return false end
        -- Another Down from the same pointer starts a new physical sequence.
        -- Its previous Up may have been lost outside the native hit surface.
        -- A different touch must never steal a live drag.
        g.input.held, g.input.released = nil, nil
        owner.gesture, owner.carry, owner.selected = nil, nil, nil
        owner.hover, owner.handHover, owner.help = nil, nil, nil
        owner.suppressClick = true
        if g.moving then host.cardView.renderDrag() end
        return true
    end
    local function reclaimPointer(event)
        if owner.active and not owner.busy and not owner.gesture and event and event.touchId == ownership.releasedDragTouch then
            ownership.releasedDragTouch = nil -- a new physical sequence owns this touch again
        end
        if not owner.gesture then owner.suppressClick = false end
    end
    local function down(event)
        -- The popup owns dismissal as well as Use/Discard. A lower native
        -- callback must not close it before its own action receives this Down.
        if owner.potionMenu then return true end
        if owner.potionAim and owner.potionAim.moving and owner.potionAim.touch~=(event and event.touchId) then return true end
        retireInterruptedPress(event)
        ownership.pointerObserved = true
        owner.help=nil
        reclaimPointer(event)
        owner.swallow = nil
        if owner.gesture then return false end
        -- Retire a changed potion context before the target captures a token.
        -- This press only cancels; a refreshed actor must need a new Down.
        if owner.active and not owner.busy and owner.potionAim and not dependencies.aimReady(owner.potionAim) then
            dependencies.cancelPotionAim("药水瞄准已失效，已取消；请重新选择药水。")
            owner.swallow = {touch = event and event.touchId}
            owner:render()
            return true
        end
        local closed,automaticCard=dependencies.closeInfo()
        if not closed or automaticCard then return false end
        owner.swallow = {touch = event and event.touchId}
        owner:render()
        return true
    end
    local function swallowed(event)
        if owner.potionMenu then return true end
        local swallow = owner.swallow
        if swallow and swallow.touch == (event and event.touchId) then owner.swallow = nil return true end
        local closed,automaticCard=dependencies.closeInfo()
        if not closed or automaticCard then return false end -- automatic card hover preserves this click
        owner:render()
        return true
    end
    local function renderAimChange(g,valid,target,aiming)
        if not host.cardView.refreshAim or not host.cardView.refreshAim(g,valid,target,aiming)then owner:render()end
    end
    local function renderCardMotion(g)
        owner.suppressClick,owner.selected = true,g.uid
        local valid, target, aiming = dependencies.dragTarget(g)
        if g.cancelled then
            g.input.held, g.input.released = nil, nil
            ownership.releasedDragTouch = g.touch
            owner.gesture, owner.selected, owner.hover, owner.handHover, owner.suppressClick = nil, nil, nil, nil, g
            owner:render(); return
        end
        if g.drawnValid ~= valid or g.drawnTarget ~= target or g.drawnAiming ~= aiming then
            renderAimChange(g,valid,target,aiming)
        else host.cardView.renderDrag(valid, target, aiming, true) end
    end
    -- Short EMA of finger velocity, kept on the gesture for a later fling port.
    local function sampleVelocity(g, x, y)
        local now = os.clock()
        local dt = now-(g.t or now)
        if dt > 0 then
            g.vx = (g.vx or 0)*0.6 + (x-g.x)/dt*0.4
            g.vy = (g.vy or 0)*0.6 + (y-g.y)/dt*0.4
        end
        g.t = now
    end
    -- 搓牌：Clash Royale 式“指下最近一张”。横向主导的按住滑动只换悬停牌，
    -- 不进入出牌拖拽；只有相对当前牌向上主导的位移才提起该牌。
    local function nearestSlot(count, x)
        local w = L.card.size[1]
        local spacing = count <= 1 and 0 or math.max(L.hand.spacingMin, math.min(L.hand.spacingMax, (L.hand.maxWidth - w) / (count - 1)))
        if spacing == 0 then return 1 end
        local index = math.floor(x/spacing + (count-1)/2 + 0.5)
        return math.max(0, math.min(count-1, index)) + 1
    end
    local function retargetHover(g, x)
        local hand = g.battle.hand
        local slot = nearestSlot(#hand, x)
        local instance = hand[slot]
        if instance and slot ~= g.slot then
            g.slot, g.uid, g.origin = slot, instance.uid, owner.cardPositions[instance.uid]
            g.bx = x
        end
        if owner.hover == g.slot then return end
        local previous=owner.hover
        owner.hover = g.slot
        owner.handHover = {run=g.run,battle=g.battle,turn=g.battle.turn,slot=g.slot,uid=g.uid}
        if host.cardView.refreshHover and host.cardView.refreshHover(previous,g.slot)then return end
        owner:render(true)
    end
    local function startBrowse(g, x, y)
        local ax, ay = math.abs(x-g.sx), math.abs(y-g.sy)
        -- 横向先过阈值且仍在手牌带才算搓牌；竖直/斜上仍走原 8px 拖拽。
        if ax < L.cardDrag.threshold or ax <= ay or y > L.hand.y + L.card.size[2]/2 then return false end
        g.browsing, g.browsed, g.bx, g.by = true, true, x, y
        return true
    end
    local function liftBrowse(g, x, y)
        local dy = y-g.by
        -- 离开手牌带，或相对当前牌向上主导：交给原拖拽/出牌流程
        if y <= L.hand.y + L.card.size[2]/2 and (dy < L.cardDrag.threshold*BROWSE_LIFT or dy <= math.abs(x-g.bx)) then return false end
        g.browsing, g.sx, g.sy = nil, g.bx, g.by
         g.intentSamples, g.playIntent = nil, nil
        owner.hover, owner.handHover = nil, nil
        return true
    end
    local function browseHand(g, x, y)
        if g.moving or g.phase ~= "combat" or not g.battle then return false end
        if not g.browsing and not startBrowse(g, x, y) then return false end
        if liftBrowse(g, x, y) then return false end
        if y < g.by then g.by = y end -- 以最低点为上推基准，下压不累计
        retargetHover(g, x)
        return true
    end
    local function move(event, input)
        if owner.potionAim and owner.potionAim.moving and dependencies.movePotion then return dependencies.movePotion(event,input) end
        local g = owner.gesture
        if not g or not event or event.touchId ~= g.touch then return end
        -- A reused touch ID does not transfer ownership between card controls.
        -- The overlay may continue only the current held gesture and card UID.
        if input and input ~= g.input or g.input.held ~= g or not dependencies.cardReady(g) then return end
        local x,y = point(event)
        if not x then return end
        sampleVelocity(g,x,y)
        g.x,g.y = x,y
        if browseHand(g,x,y) then return end
        Intent.sample(g, x, y)
        if (x-g.sx)^2+(y-g.sy)^2 >= L.cardDrag.threshold^2 then g.moving = true end
        if g.moving then renderCardMotion(g) end
    end
    updateCarry = function()
        local g = owner.carry
        if not g then return end
        if not dependencies.cardReady(g) or owner.selected ~= g.uid then owner:render(); return end
        if not host.platform.cursorPosition or g.touchScreen then return end
        local x,y = point({GetUIPos=host.platform.cursorPosition})
        if not x or x == g.x and y == g.y then return end
        g.x,g.y = x,y
        local valid,target,aiming = dependencies.dragTarget(g)
        if g.cancelled then
            owner.carry,owner.selected,owner.hover,owner.handHover = nil,nil,nil,nil
            owner:render()
        elseif g.drawnValid ~= valid or g.drawnTarget ~= target or g.drawnAiming ~= aiming then
            renderAimChange(g,valid,target,aiming)
        else host.cardView.renderDrag(valid,target,aiming,true) end
    end
    local function releaseCardTap(event, input, ended)
        local touch = event and event.touchId
        -- Missing/invalid coordinates disable dragging, not ordinary C-mode.
        local held = input and input.held
        if held and held.touch == touch then
            if owner.help and owner.help.card == held then owner.help = nil end
            input.held = nil
            input.released = not ended and dependencies.cardReady(held) and held or nil
        elseif ended and input and input.released and input.released.touch == touch then
            input.released = nil
        end
    end
    -- A clear upward throw plays a no-target card even short of the drop line,
    -- instead of snapping back like a sideways nudge through the hand.
    local function releaseAction(g, x, y, valid)
        local action = x and CardInput.release(g, valid) or 'cancel'
        if not x or action == 'play' or g.aiming or g.phase ~= "combat" or not g.battle then return action end
        if Intent.flick(g, x, y) and dependencies.cardReady(g) and Combat.canPlay(g.battle, g.uid, nil) == true then
            return 'play', true
        end
        return action
    end
    local function finishReleaseAction(action,target)
        -- playSelected retains its mandatory busy preflight. The drawn pose was
        -- already published by renderDrag; an extra nonbusy full render adds no state.
        if action=='play' and Theme.presentationProfile=='official-assets-first' then owner:playSelected(target);return end
        owner:render()
        if action=='play' then owner:playSelected(target) else dependencies.notice("") end
    end
    local function finishCardRelease(g, event, ended)
        local x, releaseY = point(event)
        local valid,target = false,nil
        if x and g.moving then valid,target = dependencies.dragTarget(g) end
        owner.gesture = nil -- consume before invoking the command or any rendering callback
        if not g.moving then
            -- 纯横向搓牌松手：保留悬停，不触发 C 模式选牌。
            if g.browsed then g.input.released, owner.suppressClick = nil, true; owner:render(true); return end
            g.input.released = not ended and g or nil
            return
        end
        g.input.released = nil
        local action, flicked = releaseAction(g, x, releaseY, valid)
        if flicked then target = nil end
        owner.carry = (action == 'target' or action == 'carry') and g or nil
        -- Keep the trailing Click bound to this drag, not a persistent global lock.
        ownership.releasedDragTouch = g.touch
        owner.suppressClick,owner.selected = g,action ~= 'cancel' and g.uid or nil
        finishReleaseAction(action,target)
    end
    local function endPointer(event,input,ended)
        local gesture=owner.gesture or owner.potionAim
        local source=input or gesture and gesture.input
        if source then dependencies.pointerEnd(source,event,ended)end
    end
    local function release(event, input, ended)
        endPointer(event,input,ended)
        if owner.potionAim and owner.potionAim.moving and dependencies.releasePotionDrag then return dependencies.releasePotionDrag(event,input) end
        local g = owner.gesture
        local touch = event and event.touchId
        if not g then releaseCardTap(event, input, ended) return end
        if touch ~= g.touch or input and input ~= g.input then return end
        if owner.help and owner.help.card == g then owner.help = nil end
        -- Stationary taps must keep their binding through Up until Click, too.
        if not dependencies.cardReady(g) then
            g.input.held = nil
            g.input.released = nil
            owner.gesture, owner.selected, owner.suppressClick = nil, nil, true
            owner:render()
            return
        end
        move(event, input)
        g.input.held = nil
        -- move/render may have cancelled a gesture belonging to an old battle.
        if owner.gesture ~= g then return end
        finishCardRelease(g, event, ended)
    end
    function owner.cancelControllerPointers(_)
        local aim=owner.potionAim
        if aim and aim.moving then ownership.releasedDragTouch=aim.touch end
        dependencies.cancelCardInputs();dependencies.cancelActionInputs();dependencies.cancelPotionInputs()
        for _,input in ipairs(ownership.enemyInputs)do dependencies.pointerClear(input) end
    end
    local function controllerReady()
        return owner.active and not owner.busy and not owner.gesture and not owner.potionMenu and owner.run
            and (owner.run.phase=="reward" or owner.run.phase=="combat" and owner.run.combat.phase=="player")
    end
    function owner.controllerBack(_)
        if dependencies.closeInfo() then owner:render();return true end
        if owner.selected or owner.potionAim then
            local movingAim=owner.potionAim and owner.potionAim.moving and owner.potionAim
            dependencies.cancelPotionAim();owner.selected,owner.carry,owner.hover=nil,nil,nil;owner.suppressClick=movingAim or false
            if movingAim then ownership.releasedDragTouch=movingAim.touch end
            owner.selectionEpoch=(owner.selectionEpoch or 0)+1
            dependencies.cancelCardInputs();dependencies.cancelActionInputs();dependencies.refresh()
            return true
        end
        if owner.run and owner.run.phase=="reward" and owner.rewardScreen=="cards" then
            dependencies.rewardScreen("list");dependencies.refresh();return true
        end
        return false
    end

    return {
        point=point, retireInterruptedPress=retireInterruptedPress, down=down, swallowed=swallowed, move=move,
        updateCarry=updateCarry, releaseCardTap=releaseCardTap, finishCardRelease=finishCardRelease, release=release, controllerReady=controllerReady
    }
end
return M

-- Read state, issue Run commands. No damage/energy/outcome rules live in this view.
local Combat = require("abyss_combat")
local Run = require("abyss_run")
local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local Feedback = require("abyss_feedback")
local CardView = require("abyss_battle_card_view")
local StatusView = require("abyss_battle_status_view")
local PotionView = require("abyss_battle_potion_view")
local PotionPopup = require("abyss_battle_potion_popup")
local IntentView = require("abyss_battle_intent_view")
local UnitView = require("abyss_battle_unit_view")
local InfoContent = require("abyss_battle_info_content")
local InfoView = require("abyss_battle_info_view")
local Controller = require("abyss_controller")
local M = {}
local C = Theme.color
local reasons = { insufficient_energy = "能量不足", invalid_target = "请选择存活的敌人", card_content_unavailable = "此卡牌尚未实装，可选择其他卡牌或跳过。",
    card_not_in_hand = "这张牌已离开手牌", not_player_turn = "敌方行动中",
    normality_limit = "平庸：本回合已打出三张牌",
    advanced_card_not_enabled = "此牌效果尚未接入", not_in_combat = "战斗已经结束",
    empty_potion_slot = "此药水已使用", invalid_potion_slot = "请选择有效药水",
    smoke_not_allowed = '此战斗不能使用烟雾弹',
    effect_overflow = "当前状态已达上限", potion_slots_full = "药水槽已满，请先丢弃旧药水。",
    potion_content_unavailable = "该稀有度药水尚未实装。", potion_blocked_by_sozu = "遗物阻止获得药水。" }
local temporaryOps = {gainTemporaryStrength=true, gainTemporaryDexterity=true}
local stanceNames={Neutral="无姿态",Calm="平静",Wrath="愤怒",Divinity="神格"}
local orbNames={lightning="闪电",frost="冰霜",dark="黑暗",plasma="等离子"}
local intentColors = { attack = C.danger, defend = C.block, buff = C.buff, debuff = C.debuff }
local kindNames = { buff = "增益", debuff = "减益" }
local statusKind = StatusView.statusKind
local statusDetail = StatusView.statusDetail
local potionText = PotionView.potionText
local intentView = IntentView.intentView
local function needsTarget(state, instance)
    -- Ask the core to validate the same card with and without a target.
    local _, reason = Combat.canPlay(state, instance.uid, nil)
    return reason == "invalid_target"
end
local function install(services, functions)
    for name, fn in pairs(functions) do services[name] = fn end
end
-- Module ports are linked once after installation, never through per-frame trampolines.
local function ports(links, names)
    local result = {}
    links[#links + 1] = {ports=result, names=names}
    return result
end
local function connect(links, services)
    for _, link in ipairs(links) do
        for _, name in ipairs(link.names) do
            link.ports[name] = assert(services[name], "missing battle port " .. name)
        end
    end
end
function M.new(root, data, presentation, clickEvent, platform, options)
    options = options or {}
    local self = { root = root, data = data, presentation = presentation, target = 1, seed = 1, busy = false, active = true }
    local ownership = {}
    local host = {root=root, platform=platform, options=options, clickEvent=clickEvent}
    local services, links = {}, {}
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_input_state").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_targeting").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "dragReady", "aimReady"
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_details").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "tint", "ink", "child", "cancelPotionAim", "cancelCardInputs",
        "cancelPotionInputs", "cancelActionInputs", "consumeReleasedDragClick", "pointerClear"
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_card_layout").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_render_state").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "aimReady", "cancelPotionAim", "cardReady", "potionReady", "actionReady",
        "enemyReady", "canHover", "rewardScreen", "label"
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_render_hud").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "show", "button", "child", "label", "tint",
        "ink"
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_render_actors").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "dragTarget", "picture", "tint", "ink", "enemySlot",
        "child", "button", "show", "potionDragTarget", "point"
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_render").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "prepareRenderInputs", "renderFeedbackReady", "syncRenderIdentity", "renderFrame", "syncRewardOwner",
        "syncRewardEntrance", "prepareRenderPotions", "renderStartControls", "rewardNavigation", "renderRewardRows",
        "renderRewardButtons", "renderPotionReward", "renderRewardStage", "renderPlayArea", "renderHudVisibility",
        "renderPlayerTotals", "renderSceneHeading", "renderEnergy", "renderPilesAndTurn", "renderResult",
        "renderEnemies", "renderDetails", "button", "renderRewardActions", "renderContinue",
        "renderPotions"
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_actions").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "sameEnemySlot", "cardReady", "cancelCardInputs", "rewardTarget", "updateCarry",
        "aimReady", "cancelPotionAim", "notice", "rewardScreen", "cancelActionInputs", "updateEnemyNames", "updateEnemyIntents"
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_card_gestures").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "closeInfo", "cardReady", "dragTarget", "notice", "cancelCardInputs",
        "cancelActionInputs", "cancelPotionInputs", "cancelPotionAim", "refresh", "rewardScreen",
        "movePotion", "releasePotionDrag", "aimReady", "pointerEnd", "pointerClear"
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_action_bindings").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "swallowed", "cardReady", "down", "point", "inPlayArea",
        "child", "controllerReady", "actionReady", "consumeReleasedDragClick", "pointerBegin", "pointerArm", "pointerEnd", "pointerTake", "pointerClear", "pointerEvent"
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_potion_bindings").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "potionBinding", "cancelPotionAim", "cancelCardInputs", "cancelActionInputs", "refresh",
        "child", "controllerReady", "swallowed", "potionReady", "down", "consumeReleasedDragClick",
        "point", "beginPotionAim", "potionDragTarget", "pointerBegin", "pointerArm", "pointerEnd", "pointerTake", "pointerClear", "pointerEvent"
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_card_bindings").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "point", "child", "controllerReady", "listen", "retireInterruptedPress",
        "down", "cancelPotionAim", "move", "release", "pointerBegin", "pointerArm"
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_target_bindings").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "child", "enemyAt", "controllerReady", "swallowed", "discardEnemyPointer",
        "enemyReady", "down", "cancelPotionAim", "sameEnemySlot", "consumeReleasedDragClick", "pointerBegin", "pointerArm", "pointerEnd", "pointerTake", "pointerClear", "pointerEvent"
    })))
    install(services, require("abyss_battle_detail_bindings").install(self, ownership, host, ports(links, {
        "enemyAt", "listen", "child", "closeInfo", "controllerReady",
        "helpActorReady", "swallowed", "down", "consumeReleasedDragClick"
    })))
    connect(links, services)
    -- Runtime bindings keep only their own ports, not the construction registry.
    services = {
        picture=services.picture, tint=services.tint, ink=services.ink, child=services.child, enemyPosition=services.enemyPosition, renderEnemies=services.renderEnemies,
        describeInfo=services.describeInfo, show=services.show, placeCard=services.placeCard, placeReward=services.placeReward, dragTarget=services.dragTarget,
        dragPose=services.dragPose, notice=services.notice, refresh=services.refresh, bind=services.bind, cancelPotionAim=services.cancelPotionAim,
        rewardScreen=services.rewardScreen, bindPotionControls=services.bindPotionControls, bindCardControls=services.bindCardControls, bindEnemyControl=services.bindEnemyControl, unbindEnemyControl=services.unbindEnemyControl,
        bindEnemyPowerControl=services.bindEnemyPowerControl, unbindEnemyPowerControl=services.unbindEnemyPowerControl,
        bindEnemyDetailControls=services.bindEnemyDetailControls, unbindEnemyDetailControls=services.unbindEnemyDetailControls, bindDetailControls=services.bindDetailControls,
        potionDragTarget=services.potionDragTarget,
        cancelCardInputs=services.cancelCardInputs, consumeReleasedDragClick=services.consumeReleasedDragClick
    }
    host.stage = host.options.embedded and host.root or assert(host.root:GetChild("stage"), "missing stage")
    host.cursor = host.platform.cursorEvents
    self.dragEnabled = host.cursor and host.cursor.CursorDown and host.cursor.CursorDrag and host.cursor.CursorUp and host.cursor.CursorEndDrag
    self.instructions = self.dragEnabled and "拖到战场出牌区域松手，目标牌拖向敌人；再点原牌取消。"
        or "点选卡牌，再点敌人或战场出牌区域；再点原牌取消。"
    -- A card click is the final event of one physical pointer sequence. Retain
    -- its original rule identity, not a global permission another Down can reset.
    ownership.cardInputs, ownership.pointerObserved, ownership.releasedDragTouch = {}, false, nil
    -- Potion controls may be click-only even when cards receive pointer events.
    -- Once a potion Down is observed, require its own one-shot release token.
    ownership.potionInputs, ownership.potionPointerObserved = {}, false
    -- Action buttons have their own pointer capability: some hosts deliver
    -- card/potion pointers but only Click for these preset buttons.
    ownership.actionInputs, ownership.actionPointerObserved, ownership.fieldPointerObserved = {}, false, false
    -- Dynamic spawns can occupy an old enemy slot. Pointer ownership follows
    -- the actor object, battle and turn, never a reusable numeric slot alone.
    ownership.enemyInputs, ownership.enemyPointerObserved = {}, false
    -- Source PC behavior: the card center follows the pointer, not the grab offset.
    -- Target cards require an explicit enemy hit, including a little touch padding.
    -- Open ground never substitutes the nearest enemy, even when only one remains.
    host.monsterSurfaces=require('abyss_monster_surfaces').new(host.stage,host.platform,function(slot,box)
        services.bindEnemyControl(slot,box);services.bindEnemyDetailControls(slot,box)
    end,function(slot,box,engineDestroyed)
        local failure
        local function cleanup(fn)local ok,why=pcall(fn);if not ok then failure=why end end
        cleanup(function()if host.monsterPowers then host.monsterPowers:release(box,engineDestroyed)end end)
        cleanup(function()if host.monsterIntentParticles then host.monsterIntentParticles:release(box,engineDestroyed)end end)
        cleanup(function()services.unbindEnemyControl(slot,box,engineDestroyed)end)
        cleanup(function()services.unbindEnemyDetailControls(slot,box,engineDestroyed)end)
        cleanup(function()if host.monsterArt and not engineDestroyed then host.monsterArt:release(box)end end)
        if failure then error(failure)end
    end)
    host.monsterArt=require('abyss_monster_art').new(host.stage,host.platform,nil,host.monsterSurfaces)
    host.monsterPowers=require('abyss_monster_power_view').new(host.platform,services.picture,services.tint,services.ink,
        function(actorSlot,powerSlot,box,pool)services.bindEnemyPowerControl(actorSlot,powerSlot,box,pool)end,
        function(_,box,engineDestroyed)services.unbindEnemyPowerControl(box,engineDestroyed)end)
    host.monsterIntentParticles=require('abyss_monster_intent_particle_view').new(host.platform,services.picture,services.tint)
    function self.releaseMonsterSurfaces(_)
        if host.cardView then host.cardView.destroy()end
        local ok,why=pcall(host.monsterSurfaces.clear,host.monsterSurfaces)
        local cleared,reason=pcall(host.monsterIntentParticles.clear,host.monsterIntentParticles)
        assert(ok and cleared,why or reason)
    end
    function self.onEngineDestroy(_)
        self.active=false
        if host.cardView then host.cardView.destroy()end
        local failure
        for _,manager in ipairs({host.monsterSurfaces,host.monsterPowers,host.monsterIntentParticles,host.monsterArt})do
            local ok,why=pcall(manager.onEngineDestroy,manager)
            if not ok then failure=why end
        end
        assert(not failure,failure)
    end
    host.unit = UnitView.new(services.picture, services.tint, services.ink, statusKind)
    host.lines = InfoContent.lines
    host.infoContent = InfoContent.new(self, {
        statusDetail = statusDetail, statusKind = statusKind, intentView = intentView, potionText = potionText,
        temporaryOps = temporaryOps, stanceNames = stanceNames, orbNames = orbNames,
        kindNames = kindNames, intentColors = intentColors,
    }, host.lines)
    host.paginate = InfoView.paginator(host.lines)
    host.renderInfo = InfoView.new(self, services.child, services.enemyPosition, services.describeInfo, host.paginate, services.tint, services.ink, services.picture)
    -- index 0 is the hero. Opening the same unit again closes it.
    -- Post-battle pick: centred cards on their own stage, never the hand arc.
    -- Hover/press only changes scale and a small lift, so a card's edge stays
    -- under the pointer and neighbours never overlap (step > hover width).
    host.cardView = CardView.new(self, {
        child = services.child, show = services.show, ink = services.ink, tint = services.tint, picture = services.picture, platform = host.platform,
        placeCard = services.placeCard, placeReward = services.placeReward,
        dragTarget = services.dragTarget, dragPose = services.dragPose, enemyPosition = services.enemyPosition,
        renderAimActors = services.renderEnemies,
        potionTarget = services.potionDragTarget,
    })
    self.feedback = Feedback.new(host.stage, host.platform, function(battle, acting)
        self.displayBattle, self.acting = battle, acting
        self:render()
    end, function(failure)
        self.busy, self.displayBattle, self.acting = false, nil, nil
        ownership.playbackIntents = nil
        local reconcileFailed,reconcileFailure=false,nil
        local sameBattle=self.feedbackRun and self.feedbackRun==self.run
            and self.feedbackBattle and self.feedbackBattle==self.run.combat
        if failure and sameBattle then
            local ok,why=pcall(host.monsterIntentParticles.reconcile,host.monsterIntentParticles,self.feedbackBattle)
            if not ok then reconcileFailed,reconcileFailure=true,why end
        end
        if sameBattle and #self.feedbackBattle.events == self.feedbackLast then
            -- UI is the event consumer. Release consumed frames; the event table identity stays stable.
            for i = #self.feedbackBattle.events, 1, -1 do self.feedbackBattle.events[i] = nil end
        end
        local notice=""
        if failure then notice="演出已恢复，可继续行动。" end
        services.notice(notice)
        local refreshed,why=pcall(services.refresh,failure ~= "cancelled")
        if reconcileFailed then
            local message='source intent reconciliation failed after '..tostring(failure)..': '..tostring(reconcileFailure)
            if not refreshed then message=message..'; refresh failed: '..tostring(why)end
            error(message)
        end
        if not refreshed then error(why)end
    end)
    -- An open detail panel owns the next pointer sequence: its Down closes the panel and
    -- the matching Click is swallowed, so no card, target or button acts underneath it.
    host.controller=host.platform.controller
    services.bind("start", function() if not self.run or self.run.phase == "defeat" then self:start() end end)
    services.bind("endTurn", function() self:endTurn() end)
    services.bind("playArea", function()
        if services.cancelPotionAim("已取消药水瞄准。") then services.refresh() return end
        local battle = self.run and self.run.phase == "combat" and self.run.combat
        if not battle then return end
        for _,instance in ipairs(battle.hand) do
            if instance.uid == self.selected and not needsTarget(battle,instance) then self:playSelected(nil) return end
        end
    end)
    services.bind("skip", function()
        if not self.active or not self.run or self.busy or self.run.phase ~= "reward" or self.rewardScreen ~= "cards" then return end
        -- PC SkipCardButton closes the picker; the unclaimed CARD row remains.
        services.rewardScreen("list")
        services.notice("")
        services.refresh()
    end)
    services.bind("cardReward", function()
        if not self.active or self.busy or not self.run or self.run.phase ~= "reward"
            or self.rewardScreen ~= "list" or self.run.rewards.cardResolved then return end
        local Cards=require('abyss_relic_card_rewards')
        if Cards.managed(self.run)then
            local ok=Cards.open(self.run,self.rewardOwner)
            if ok then services.notice('');services.refresh(true)end
            return ok
        end
        services.rewardScreen("cards")
        services.notice("")
        services.refresh()
    end)
    services.bind("goldReward", function()
        if not self.active or self.busy or self.rewardScreen ~= "list" or not self.run then return end
        local ok = Run.claimGoldReward(self.run)
        if ok then services.notice("金币已领取。") services.refresh(true) end
    end)
    services.bind('emeraldKeyReward',function()
        if not self.active or self.busy or self.rewardScreen~='list' or not self.run then return false end
        local ok,why=Run.claimEmeraldKey(self.run)
        if ok then services.notice('已获得绿钥匙。');services.refresh(true)end
        return ok,why
    end)
    for i=1,2 do
        local slot=i
        services.bind('relicReward'..slot,function()
            if not self.active or self.busy or self.rewardScreen~='list' or not self.run then return false end
            local receipt=self.run.lastRelicObtain
            local sequence=receipt and receipt.sequence or 0
            local ok,why=Run.claimRelicReward(self.run,slot)
            if ok then
                local names=require('abyss_relic_names')
                services.notice('已获得遗物「'..names.get(self.run.data,why)..'」'..names.upgradeFeedback(self.run,sequence,presentation,why))
                services.refresh(true)
            end
            return ok,why
        end)
    end
    services.bind("claimPotion", function() return self:claimPotionReward() end)
    services.bind("stolenGold", function()
        if self.active and self.run and not self.busy and self.rewardScreen == "list"
            and Run.claimStolenGoldReward(self.run) then services.notice("已取回失金。") services.refresh(true) end
    end)
    services.bind("continue", function()
        if not self.active or self.busy or not self.run then return end
        if self.run.phase == "reward" then
            if self.rewardScreen ~= "list" then return end
            local ok,reason=Run.leaveCombatRewards(self.run)
            if not ok then services.notice(reasons[reason] or "当前无法离开奖励。") end
            services.refresh(ok)
        elseif not host.options.embedded and self.run.phase == "map" then assert(Run.startCombat(self.run, "cultist_solo")) services.refresh(true) end
    end)
    host.potionPopup=PotionPopup.new(host.stage:GetChild('potionHelp'):GetChild('potionPopup'),self,host.platform,host.clickEvent,{
        pointerDown=function(event)
            if self.active and not self.busy and not self.gesture then
                if event and event.touchId==ownership.releasedDragTouch then ownership.releasedDragTouch=nil end
                self.suppressClick=false
            end
        end,
        pointerClick=function(event,token)
            local origin=token and {touchId=token.touch} or event
            return not services.consumeReleasedDragClick(origin) and not self.suppressClick and not self.gesture
        end,
        pointerConsumed=function(event,token)
            -- Only a host with neither Down nor Up is truly click-only. Partial
            -- pointer capabilities still need the attributed tail barrier.
            if not (host.cursor and (host.cursor.CursorDown or host.cursor.CursorUp)) then return end
            -- Reuse the finite release barrier after the popup command closes
            -- its menu. Keep the owned ID and the native Click's one ambiguous
            -- tail separately when that Click omitted its ID.
            local touch=token and token.touch or event and event.touchId
            ownership.releasedDragTouch=touch;self.suppressClick={touch=event and event.touchId}
        end,
        item=function(slot)return Run.potionSlotView(self.run,slot)end,
        text=function(item,battle)return potionText(item,battle,true):match("\n(.*)") or ''end,
        use=function(slot)return self:usePotion(slot)end,
        discard=function(slot)
            local ok,reason=Run.discardPotion(self.run,slot)
            if ok then self.potionSlots[slot]=nil end
            services.notice(ok and '已丢弃药水。' or reasons[reason] or '当前不能丢弃此药水。')
            services.refresh();return ok,reason
        end,
        changed=function()services.refresh()end,
    })
    services.bindPotionControls()
    services.bindCardControls()
    services.bindDetailControls()
    for _,kind in ipairs({'draw','discard','exhaust'})do
        local hit=services.child(kind..'Icon'):GetChild('hit')
        local function available()
            return host.options.onPile~=nil and self.active and not self.busy and not self.gesture and not self.carry
                and self.run and self.run.phase=='combat' and self.run.combat.phase=='player'
        end
        local function openPile()
            if available()then
                return host.options.onPile(kind)
            end
            return false
        end
        hit:AddCursorEventListener(host.clickEvent,function()
            if Controller.pointerBlocked(host.controller)then return false end
            return openPile()
        end)
        Controller.bind(host.controller,hit,'battle',openPile,available,80)
    end
    local keys = host.platform.keyEvents
    if keys and keys.KeyboardSprintKeyDown and host.root.AddKeyEventListener then
        -- The official UI maps SprintKey to the user's right-mouse binding.
        host.root:AddKeyEventListener(keys.KeyboardSprintKeyDown, function()
            if not self.active or not (self.gesture or self.carry or self.selected) then return false end
            services.cancelCardInputs()
            self.gesture,self.carry,self.selected,self.hover = nil,nil,nil,nil
            self.suppressClick = true
            self:render()
            return true
        end)
    end
    services.refresh()
    return self
end
return M
